name: local-review
description: Skills and hooks for local-review (lr): plan, implement, review, and revise jj stacks with agent and human reviewers. Needs the lr CLI on your PATH.

stop_reminder.title: Remind Claude to open a review round
stop_reminder.description: When Claude stops with changes on the feature's stack that no review round has seen, remind it once to run `lr review create` (or say what's left).
